stem_book: One root of the cubic 2z³ − (5 + 6i)z² + 9iz + 1 − 3i = 0 is real. If all the three roots of this cubic are plotted on the complex plane, then find the area of the triangle formed by them.
reason: Out of scope: asks for the area of a triangle in the Argand plane (geometry). Print typo 'the find' corrected to 'then find'.
work: imag: 2t² − 3t + 1 = 0 and real: 2t³ − 5t² + 1 = 0 ⇒ t = 1/2; other roots 1 + i, 1 + 2i ⇒ area = (1/2)·1·(1/2) = 1/4
